howto.h1: How to play, deposit and withdraw
howto.intro: {brand} lets you bet USDT on the outcome of real events: football, NBA, crypto up/down and macro news. The probabilities you see are what real-money bettors think. The platform never takes the other side; it only takes a fee from winners' profit.

sections.heading: How to play
items: Each market has two or more options, and each option has its own pool. The USDT you bet goes into the pool of the option you pick.

When the result is in, the pools of the losing options are shared among the winners in proportion to their bets. The platform only takes a fee on winners' profit ({fee} by default; each market shows its own rate). Losing bets pay no fee.
The odds move as the pools change and are fixed when betting closes. What you see before you bet is an estimate; the final odds are the ones at close. Bets cannot be cancelled.
If only one option has bets when betting closes, or nobody bet on the result, the market is voided and every bet is refunded in full.
Cancelled and voided markets are refunded in full, with no fee.

How results are decided: crypto markets use public Binance and OKX prices automatically; sports use the scores from two data sources; other markets are resolved by the platform, the result is shown publicly first, and anyone who bet can raise a dispute.

sections.heading: How to deposit
items: Only USDT. Three networks: TRC20 (TRON), ERC20 (Ethereum) and BSC (BEP20). The networks shown under Assets → Deposit are the ones open right now.
Every account has its own deposit address. Send USDT from an exchange or wallet; it is credited automatically after the block confirmations.
Send USDT only, on the same network as the address. Coins sent on the wrong network or in the wrong token may not be recoverable.
Once your total deposits exceed {kycThreshold} USDT, you need to verify your identity before placing more bets.

sections.heading: How to withdraw
items: The minimum withdrawal is {minWithdraw} USDT.
Before your first withdrawal you need to verify your identity (ID document plus a face check).
Withdrawal addresses go on a whitelist first; a new address can be used {whitelistHours} hours after you add it.
Every withdrawal has a {coolingHours}-hour cooling period; withdrawals of {largeThreshold} USDT or more wait another {largeDelayHours} hours.
Withdrawals that include winnings are checked by a person before they are sent (usually within one business day).
The network fee for each chain is shown on the withdrawal page.

howto.description: 彩池怎么算、USDT 支持哪几条链、提现规则：单笔最少 {minWithdraw} USDT、证件 + 人脸认证、地址白名单和冷静期。
howto.intro: {brand} 是一个用 USDT 押事件结果的网站：足球、NBA、加密货币涨跌、经济时事。你看到的概率是散户用真钱投票的概率。平台不当庄，只从赢家的盈利里抽成。

sections.heading: 怎么玩
items: 每个市场有两个或更多选项，每个选项有自己的奖池。你押哪个选项，钱就进哪个选项的奖池。
开奖后，没押中的选项的奖池按押注比例分给押中的人；平台只对赢家的盈利部分抽成（默认 {fee}，每个市场的费率写在市场详情里），没押中不收费。
赔率随奖池变化，截止下注时确定；下注时看到的是预计赔率，最终以截止时为准。下注后不能撤销。
截止时只有一个选项有人押，或者没有人押中结果，这个市场作废，所有下注全额退回。
市场被取消或作废时全额退款，不收任何费用。
结果怎么判：加密市场按币安、OKX 的公开行情自动判定；体育按两个数据来源的比分；其他市场由平台裁决，结果先公示，下注的人可以提出争议。

sections.heading: 怎么充
items: 只收 USDT，支持三条链：TRC20（波场）、ERC20（以太坊）、BSC（BEP20）；以“资产 → 充值”里显示可用的网络为准。
每个账户有自己的充值地址。从交易所或钱包转入 USDT，区块确认后自动到账。
只转 USDT，网络要和地址一致；转错网络或币种可能找不回。
累计充值超过 {kycThreshold} USDT 后，要先完成身份认证才能继续下注。

sections.heading: 怎么提
items: 单笔最少提现 {minWithdraw} USDT。
第一次提现前要完成身份认证（证件 + 人脸）。
提现地址要先加进白名单，新地址 {whitelistHours} 小时后才能用。
每笔提现有 {coolingHours} 小时冷静期；单笔 {largeThreshold} USDT 及以上的大额提现再延迟 {largeDelayHours} 小时。
有盈利的提现由人工复核后放行（一般 1 个工作日内）。
各条链的提现手续费在提现页显示。
